title: Pull Up Constructor Body

solutions.title: One shared prologue, computed before super() where it has to be
solutions.tradeoff: Enrolment's constructor now demands three already-finished values instead of letting each subclass fill in its own fields at its own pace, so a fourth shared field has to be threaded through every subclass's super() call instead of just being assigned.

reviewFocus: Does Enrolment's constructor read anything through `this` before super() has returned, or does every value it needs arrive as an already-computed parameter?
Are sessionsPerTerm and ratePerSessionCents still stored as fields anywhere, now that nothing outside the constructor ever read them?
Does the walkthrough show why moving `this.tuitionCents = this.sessionsPerTerm * this.ratePerSessionCents` up verbatim fails, rather than just asserting that it does?
Do PrivateLessonEnrolment and GroupLessonEnrolment still each validate the student name themselves, or is that check made exactly once, in Enrolment?
Does the walkthrough name which of the four docs/NAMING.md questions decided `tuitionCents`, `SESSIONS_PER_TERM`, or `instrumentTutor` - and which rejected candidate each one beat?
